name: Teyla
tagline: The control room for AI agents on one Mac.

highlights.label: COST
highlights.title: 30 days of agent spend, priced
highlights.text: Finds the waste and offers undoable fixes, each with its saving.

highlights.label: PACKS
highlights.title: Ten packs, you tick what you want
highlights.text: Cost, load, disk, inbox, policy, security, design, ship, writing.

highlights.label: INBOX
highlights.title: Every open question on one screen
highlights.text: Answer by text or voice, from the Mac, Telegram or iPhone.

highlights.label: POLICY
highlights.title: One policy for every agent
highlights.text: Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor and Hermes read the same file.

highlights.label: PRODUCTS
highlights.title: One line per product
highlights.text: Health, builds that reached a tester, and what each one is missing.

highlights.label: LOCAL
highlights.title: Nothing leaves your Mac
highlights.text: No server, no account. Each outside call is off or listed.

steps.title: Undo any change
steps.text: Every change has a way back.
